name: ntr_db_wh_Points_goal_payout
xsql:
SELECT 
    Coalesce(initial_patients_payout, '0.00') AS initial_patients_payout,
    Coalesce(initial_patients_percentage || '%', '0.00%') AS initial_patients_percentage_of_onc
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        -- 1. Format the total payout for Initial Patients
        FormatNumber(
            SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 
            '#,##0.00'
        ) AS initial_patients_payout,
        
        -- 2. Calculate the raw percentage relative to the total ONC category payout
        Round(
            (SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Points Goal' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
            CASE WHEN SUM(p.amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(p.amount) END, 
            2
        ) AS initial_patients_percentage
    FROM xactly.xc_payment p
    
    -- Embedded Title Mapping
    INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_title_mapping pta
        ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
    
    -- Embedded Territory Mapping
    INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_territory_mapping ter
        ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id
    
    -- Configuration Mappings scoped directly to the ONC category
    INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
        ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
       AND pta.title_name = m.title
       AND m.category = 'WH'
          INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
  
    LEFT JOIN NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
        ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
        
    WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
      AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
            AND (:p_region = 'ALL' or pos_reg.region in (:p_region))
) AggData ON 1=1
